name: Google Shopping price drops to Slack (Apify)

parameters.content:
## Google Shopping price-drop alert
1. Create a free Apify account and copy your API token (console.apify.com/settings/integrations).
2. Add a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
3. Put the products you watch in **Search Google Shopping** (`queries`, exact model names work best) and set `country`.
4. Connect Slack and pick a channel.

The first run records every listing's price; after that you only hear about drops (per store). Cost: $1 per 1,000 products returned, a few cents a month.

httpHeaderAuth.name: Apify API token (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <token>)
